messages:
oliver: quick async standup — one-liners today. onboarding: pushed v2 tokenizer fix to the intake branch, ran full eval sweep last night.
sophie: nice, saw the CI run. failing case is `promptset_spanish_date` still regressing by 6% on exact-match.
jamal: blocker: I can't repro locally for that sample — local tokenization seems fine. asking if anyone ran the eval with `--seed 42` and quantized weights?
maria: I ran a quick ablation: quantization + longprefix -> mismatch on date normalization. suspect kv-cache warmup bug. leaving logs in /tmp/regress-174872.
oliver: thanks @maria. action: can you drop the failing outputs here or paste a short diff? if kv warmup, we should try a short prefix warmup run.
maria: pasted short excerpt: ```diff
- 2023-03-05
+ 03 de marzo 2023
```
kyle: FYI I'm on the rollout for the smallq variant today — will hold canary if this persists. ping me if we need a rollback.
sophie: suggestion: add a prompt normalization step in the eval harness (strip date formats) so we can isolate tokenization vs model behavior. pro: faster triage. con: might hide real regressions. thoughts?
jamal: agree on isolation. +1 to a short normalization pass for the eval pipeline only (flagged). I can open a tiny PR.
eval-bot: eval-run finished: 174 tests, 12 regressions flagged (see dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/evals/1748723456).
oliver: good, can someone take ownership of the hotlist? I can do prioritization after Jamal's PR.
maria: I'll take repro ownership for the Spanish date cases and try warmup-only runs.
kyle: I'll standby for canary flags. if Maria repros, I'll block rollout and notify SRE.
sophie: yesterday: cleaned promptset dedupe for onboarding streams. today: will add a short normalization option and review Jamal's PR.
jamal: I'll open PR in ~30m: `evals: add --normalize-dates` with tests.
oliver: tiny logistics: team sync moved to 2pm PT today; if you need a quick pairing on the repro ping @oliver and I'll join.
maria: noted. thanks all — will report back with repro or next steps by EOD. :thumbsup:
kyle: +1
sophie: :rocket:
